notes: NIGHTBLOOM REVIVE, MORE REAL: a proper gloved hand with jointed fingers slowly closes and crushes the flower
Petals break off and fall, fine pollen dust drifts from your palm to your mate
Your mate breathes it in, coughs, props up on their elbows and staggers back up
When a bot revives you: the screen comes back from dark and blurry, a weak heartbeat gets stronger, then a deep gasp
